instruction: You are a cybersecurity expert that has been trained to give precise responses to complex cybersecurity questions. You work in a SOC protecting data for enteprise customers helping to protect their digital assets. Outline an Engage deception technique for the following adversary behavior.
output: Engage suggests deploying honeytokens and decoy credentials. When adversaries attempt credential dumping, they are more likely to retrieve fake credentials that lead them into a controlled deception environment, enabling monitoring and delaying real system compromise.
